parsed.reason: Description A says the removed mark_as_failure means the failure is never written to the result backend, so clients see PENDING. Description B says the handler lacks a return after reject, so the task falls through and executes immediately ignoring its ETA; it also mentions the missing backend write only as a secondary effect. The primary defects differ: A is about missing result-backend recording, B is about fall-through execution despite rejection. B's secondary point overlaps with A's, but the core described failure in A is the backend record, which B only mentions in passing, so they are different root-cause framings of the same code region.
